Aegon Targaryen. Conqueror. Unifier. Legend.
This is the story of Aegon the Conqueror — told in first person. A man who didn't come to destroy, but to unite seven kingdoms under one banner.
🎬 Part 1 is already on the channel — make sure you've watched it first.
